newsitem.title: FRANCE: Generale des Eaux falls on downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Generale des Eaux falls on downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Generale des Eaux fell on Tuesday after broker SGE Delahaye downgraded the stock to neutral from outperform, fund managers said.

The broker considerd "the intrinsic value of Generale des Eaux does not offer the potential for outperformance," and that the stock "is not in line with the main themes in the market," such as cyclical and consumer-led stocks, they said.
Generale des Eaux was down 1.49 percent at 729 francs at 1110 GMT, on volume of 179,397 shares, while the market was down 0.93 percent.
